source.quote_free_summary: The complete list of officials (organizers, chairmen of judges, adjudicators, scrutineers, registrars, MCs, music directors), each category alphabetical by last name, and the total prize money must be posted on a website at least thirty days before the competition.

requirement: Publication record covers the complete list of every listed category, alphabetically ordered, with a fingerprint; hard blocker to the NDCA profile until recorded at least 30 days before the event.

interpretation_notes: Wider scope than panel judges. DanceFlow cannot verify website posting. Prize money posting is out of scope here. NOT IMPLEMENTED (design only, PR-A section 6D): a BLOCKER to activating an NDCA profile; no test; no compliance claimed.
